description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of the primary sexual characteristics over time, from their formation to the mature structures. The primary sexual characteristics are the testes in males and the ovaries in females and they develop in response to sex hormone secretion. [GOC:ai]
label: DEVELOPMENT OF PRIMARY SEXUAL CHARACTERISTICS *

description: The establishment of the sex of an organism by physical differentiation. [GOC:ai]
label: SEX DIFFERENTIATION *

description: The cell cycle process in which the sister chromatids of a replicated chromosome are joined along the entire length of the chromosome, from their formation in S phase through metaphase during a mitotic cell cycle. This cohesion cycle is critical for high fidelity chromosome transmission. [GOC:ai, GOC:rn, PMID:10827941, PMID:11389843, PMID:14623866]
label: MITOTIC SISTER CHROMATID COHESION *

description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of the primary female sexual characteristics over time, from their formation to the mature structure. The primary female sexual characteristics are the ovaries, and they develop in response to sex hormone secretion. [GOC:ai]
label: DEVELOPMENT OF PRIMARY FEMALE SEXUAL CHARACTERISTICS *

description: The progression of the reproductive system over time from its formation to the mature structure. The reproductive system consists of the organs that function in reproduction. [GOC:dph]
label: REPRODUCTIVE SYSTEM DEVELOPMENT *

description: Mitotic bipolar spindle assembly begins with spindle microtubule nucleation from the separated spindle pole body, includes spindle elongation during prometaphase, and is complete when all kinetochores are stably attached the spindle, and the spindle assembly checkpoint is satisfied. [GOC:tb, GOC:vw]
label: MITOTIC SPINDLE ASSEMBLY *

description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of the spindle, the array of microtubules and associated molecules that forms between opposite poles of a eukaryotic cell during DNA segregation and serves to move the duplicated chromosomes apart. [GOC:go_curators, GOC:mah]
label: SPINDLE ORGANIZATION *

description: The assembly or remodeling of chromatin composed of DNA complexed with histones, other associated proteins, and sometimes RNA. [PMID:20404130]
label: CHROMATIN ORGANIZATION *

description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate, or extent of an immune system process. [GOC:add]
label: POSITIVE REGULATION OF IMMUNE SYSTEM PROCESS *

description: The appearance of a cytokine due to biosynthesis or secretion following a cellular stimulus, resulting in an increase in its intracellular or extracellular levels. [GOC:add, ISBN:0781735149]
label: CYTOKINE PRODUCTION *

description: Any process that activates or increases the rate or extent of cell proliferation. [GOC:go_curators]
label: POSITIVE REGULATION OF CELL POPULATION PROLIFERATION *

description: The immediate defensive reaction (by vertebrate tissue) to infection or injury caused by chemical or physical agents. The process is characterized by local vasodilation, extravasation of plasma into intercellular spaces and accumulation of white blood cells and macrophages. [GO_REF:0000022, ISBN:0198506732]
label: INFLAMMATORY RESPONSE *

description: Any process of the immune system that executes a component of an immune response. An effector immune process takes place after its activation. [GO_REF:0000022, GOC:add, ISBN:0781735149]
label: IMMUNE EFFECTOR PROCESS *

description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of locomotion of a cell or organism. [GOC:go_curators]
label: POSITIVE REGULATION OF LOCOMOTION *

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of an immune effector process. [GOC:add]
label: REGULATION OF IMMUNE EFFECTOR PROCESS *

description: A vesicle-mediated transport process that results in the engulfment of external particulate material by phagocytes and their delivery to the lysosome. The particles are initially contained within phagocytic vacuoles (phagosomes), which then fuse with primary lysosomes to effect digestion of the particles. [ISBN:0198506732]
label: PHAGOCYTOSIS *
